classes.signature_description: A broad learned psychic repertoire constrained by distinct powers per eligible rest: 1 + class level/4. Repeated casts and augmentation share the same power identity. Saved across encounters and reloads; only an eligible rest resets the list.

mechanically_functional.scope: Legal progression and owned direct effects; not complete career/tactical coverage

automated_tested.scope: Class birth, every level and exact cold snapshot

native_windows.scope: The exact containing pack was validated and exported on Windows. Individual selection/effect execution is claimed only by the separate evidence stages above, not inferred from packaging.
